as_told.title: Pablo Amaringo's flying saucers as vehicles for the spirit world

plain: The Peruvian painter and former shaman Pablo Amaringo told the writer Graham Hancock, matter-of-factly, that the flying saucers in his visions were "vehicles for entering and leaving the spirit world." Hancock, who writes about lost civilisations and altered states, relays this on two episodes from his meeting with Amaringo in the Peruvian Amazon, around 2005, and credits his book Supernatural. In the later episode he dates it more loosely and also credits a book called Visionary. If true, it would tie UFOs to the spirit visions of Amazon shamans.
